<function name="SetIsViewModelEffect" parent="CNewParticleEffect" type="classfunc">
	<description>Set whether this particle effect is a view model effect or not. This will have an effect on attachment positioning and other things.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="isViewModel" type="boolean">Whether this particle effect is a view model effect or not.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
